verdict.rationale: Bitwarden stores TOTP seeds in the vault ([bitwarden-docs-1]). Its Authenticator app can sync verification codes with Password Manager ([bitwarden-docs-2]), so signing in on a new phone should bring tokens along. Import and export paths from Google Authenticator, LastPass and 2FAS cover other migrations ([bitwarden-docs-14]). However, the evidence never describes a dedicated, guided phone-to-phone transfer: sync has to be activated, and the export/import route is manual and multi-step. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented one-step new-device migration flow, confirmation that all tokens transfer automatically on sign-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration experience.
